title: uno — Ultimate Nostalgia Online
description: uno (Ultimate Nostalgia Online): famous games remastered with multiplayer and new mechanics, free in your browser. Zerod is out now; Pebo and Ogro Party are coming soon.
ogImageAlt: uno logo and the line Ultimate Nostalgia Online. Famous games remastered with multiplayer and new mechanics.
intro: Famous games remastered with multiplayer and new mechanics, free to play with your friends in the browser.

zerod.name: Zerod
zerod.text: A free card game for up to 12 friends. Open a room, send the code and play in the browser.

pebo.name: Pebo
pebo.text: Online 3D foosball. Teams of 1, 2 or 4 players, with just a nickname.

ogro-party.name: Ogro Party
ogro-party.text: Nine minigames in the mud. Up to 8 players, online, in the browser.
